AppSec / AI Security Engineer

About the Role
Were embedding security and AI governance into the core of our software development lifecycle. This role owns the design and implementation of automated security scanning, code provenance, and governance processes to ensure AI-generated code meets the highest security and compliance standards. If youre a self-driven engineer who enjoys building security automation from the ground up and weaving security seamlessly into development pipelines, this role is for you.
Employment Type: Full-time
Location: Indore (Work from Office)
Key Responsibilities
Build and integrate robust security controls into CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated scanning for source code, dependencies, secrets, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), with security gates enforced on every merge.
Design and implement code provenance tracking to identify AI-generated code, record the AI models used, and capture reviewer approvals throughout the development lifecycle.
Establish structured code review workflows that incorporate technical specifications, security scan results, and code provenance for comprehensive security validation.
Optimize security scanning tools and workflows to minimize false positives, improve signal quality, and drive greater developer adoption.
Investigate, prioritize, and manage security findings through established remediation, tracking, and documentation processes.
Contribute to AI governance standards by defining secure practices for AI tool usage and establishing controls for AI-generated code.
Conduct independent security assessments of internally developed, third-party, and vendor-supplied code to ensure alignment with organizational security standards and requirements.
Required Skills & Experience
Demonstrated experience implementing automated security scanning, policy enforcement, and security gates rather than simply operating existing tools.
Strong knowledge of SAST, SCA, secret scanning, DAST, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security scanning practices and tools.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, with hands-on or working knowledge of AWS and Azure preferred.
Ability to design, build, and own security automation and governance solutions from the ground up.
Strong security judgment with the ability to balance risk reduction and developer productivity by minimizing unnecessary alerts and false positives.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex security risks into clear, concise, and business-friendly language.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently assess security risks across internal, third-party, and external codebases.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience securing AI-generated code, with knowledge of LLM security risks, prompt injection, code provenance, and AI governance.
Hands-on experience with security tools such as Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Gitleaks, TruffleHog, Prowler, Trivy, or similar solutions.
AWS certification, preferably Solutions Architect Associate, or willingness to obtain the certification within 90 days.
Security certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, CSSLP, or equivalent are preferred.
Experience developing custom security detection rules and policies, including custom Semgrep rules.

jobs.job_description:
Role & Responsibilities

Conversational AI & Chatbot Development

Design and implement intelligent chatbot solutions using modern LLMs like GPT-4, Claude, LLaMA, etc.
Build prompt strategies, chains, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines for enhanced context-aware responses.
Integrate chatbot systems with APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.
Optimize model usage to balance cost, latency, and accuracy.
Develop fallback logic, session tracking, and context management for multi-turn conversations.
Ensure secure, ethical, and responsible AI usage.
AI/ML for Predictive Analytics
Analyze historical and real-time data to identify trends, anomalies, and patterns.
Work with structured and unstructured data including text, time series, and tabular data.
Present actionable insights from models to stakeholders in clear and explainable ways.

Architecture & Deployment

Design and maintain scalable AI/ML pipelines and architecture.
Use MLOps tools to automate model training, testing, deployment, and monitoring (e.g., MLflow, DVC, Airflow, Kubeflow).
Integrate models into production-grade applications using APIs and cloud ML services.

Qualifications

4 years of relevant experience in AI Engineering.
Strong experience with LLM-based chatbot frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Langgraph, etc.
Expertise in prompt engineering, embeddings, and transformer-based models.
Proficiency in Python (preferred) or other languages for ML and scripting.
Familiarity with data pipelines, feature stores, and ETL processes.
Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate).
Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms, statistics, and data modeling.

AI Engineer

Experience

4 to 12 years of software engineering experience with hands-on experience in AI/GenAI application development
Experience building and deploying AI-enabled products, platforms, or enterprise solutions
Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience across backend systems, APIs, and cloud-native applications
Experience leading small teams or driving delivery across multiple engineers/workstreams
Comfortable working with Product, Engineering, and Architecture stakeholders

GenAI & Agentic Development

Design and build GenAI applications using frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, or similar
Develop RAG-based solutions including ingestion, retrieval, orchestration, and response generation
Build agentic workflows involving tool usage, memory, and multi-step task execution
Integrate LLMs and AI services into enterprise applications and business processes
Drive adoption of AI-native engineering practices within the team

Technical Skills

Strong programming skills in Python and modern software engineering frameworks
Experience with LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent
Experience building APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications
Familiarity with vector databases, retrieval systems, and prompt engineering techniques
Working knowledge of CI/CD, containers, and cloud deployment practices

Delivery & Team Leadership

Lead delivery of AI engineering workstreams and key product features
Mentor and guide engineers on solution design, coding practices, and AI adoption
Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions
Drive engineering quality, delivery predictability, and operational excellence

AI Engineering Practices

Define and promote best practices around prompt design, model evaluation, and AI application development
Leverage AI tools to improve engineering productivity and speed of delivery
Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to apply them within products
